readout_other: DTI fractional anisotropy and T2* maps of the substantia nigra at 3.0 T; TH and GDNF immunohistochemistry
direction_notes: LITUS group showed lower FA and higher T2* in the lesioned right SN than the untreated hemi-PD group at weeks 5 and 6, interpreted as neuroprotection; excitatory or inhibitory direction not assessed.

target.label: The stimulation site was the same side of the brain as the drug injection site.

timing.protocol_description: Total stimulation duration was 10 min with a total of 200 trials; the stimulation duration (SD) and tone-burst duration (TBD) were 400 and 0.5 ms at PRF 1 kHz. Stimulation was applied daily after the surgical procedure.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Rats were randomly divided into two groups: (1) a hemi-PD group (n = 10) and (2) a LITUS group (n = 10).
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: A commercial ultrasonic brain stimulator (DK-102T, Dukang Medical Devices, Co., Ltd., Shijiazhuang, China) was used to produce the transcranial ultrasound used in the experiments.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: A commercial ultrasonic brain stimulator (DK-102T, Dukang Medical Devices, Co., Ltd., Shijiazhuang, China) was used to produce the transcranial ultrasound used in the experiments.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound fundamental frequency (FF) and pulserepetition frequency (PRF) were 500 and 1 kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The ultrasound fundamental frequency (FF) and pulserepetition frequency (PRF) were 500 and 1 kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The ultrasound stimulation duration (SD) and tone-burst duration (TBD) parameters were 400 and 0.5 ms, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The ultrasound stimulation duration (SD) and tone-burst duration (TBD) parameters were 400 and 0.5 ms, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.isppa_w_: The ultrasound pressure was measured using a calibrated needle-type hydrophone (HNR500, Onda, Sunnyvale, CA, United States), and the spatial peak and pulse-average intensity (Isppa) was $2 . 6 ~ \mathrm { W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { \hat { 2 } }$ (Liu et al., 2019).
